description: Scan a DEPLOYED website's HTML, JavaScript bundles and source maps for an exposed Supabase service_role key (a service_role JWT or an sb_secret_... key), and check whether /.env is downloadable (fail), /.git/ is served (fail) or source maps are public (warn). Needs only the public URL: no database, no credentials. A found service key bypasses ALL Row Level Security, giving anyone full read/write to the database. Also reports whether the public anon/publishable key is present, which means RLS is the only lock (follow up with audit_supabase_rls). Use right after deploying a Supabase app. Never prints a key or an .env value. Does not touch the database; for that, use audit_supabase_rls.

max_scripts.description: How many JS bundles to read (default 50). If the site has more, the result says how many went unscanned instead of implying it looked at all.

site_url.description: Public https URL of the deployed site to scan (e.g. https://myapp.com). Only public http(s) hosts are allowed.

name: scan_site_for_exposed_key
